Transaction value based on SEC Form 4 weighted average purchase price ($8.84); post-transaction value based on Aug. 14, 2026, market close ($9.13).

Key questions

What is the magnitude of this purchase relative to the officer's previous position?

The acquisition of 25,000 shares represents a 250% increase in the insider's direct equity holdings, from 10,000 to 35,000.

What were the market conditions at the time of the trade?

Shares were purchased at $8.84, while the stock was priced at $9.13 as of the Aug. 14, 2026, market close. As of this writing, the stock price has dropped 16.8% over the last 12 months.

Are there other share classes or indirect holdings to consider?

The filing indicates no indirect holdings and no other share classes for this reporting owner; the entire 35,000-share position is held directly through Class A Ordinary Shares.

Company Overview

Share Price (as of market close 2026-08-14)

$9.13

Market Capitalization

$2.1 billion

Revenue (TTM)

$812.3 million

Net Income (TTM)

-$228.5 million

Company Snapshot

Bitdeer Technologies operates a diversified cryptocurrency mining business, generating revenue through its proprietary digital asset mining operations and by providing comprehensive mining solutions to institutional and retail clients.

The company's business model centers on extracting cryptocurrencies for its own portfolio while simultaneously offering end-to-end mining services, including hardware sourcing, logistics management, and operational support across the entire mining lifecycle.

Bitdeer serves a global community of mining clients ranging from individual miners to institutional participants seeking to optimize their cryptocurrency mining operations through the company's integrated technology platform and infrastructure solutions.

Story Continues

Bitdeer Technologies is a Singapore-headquartered technology enterprise with a market capitalization of $2.1 billion. The company has established itself as a significant player in the cryptocurrency mining sector, generating $812.3 million in TTM revenue while managing the complexities of digital asset extraction and the provisioning of mining infrastructure. Despite current profitability challenges, as reflected in a TTM net loss of $228.5 million, Bitdeer maintains a comprehensive competitive position through its vertically integrated approach to mining hardware sourcing, logistics optimization, and proprietary mining technology deployment.

What this transaction means for investors

There are plenty of reasons to sell a stock, but insider buying is notable, particularly at this level. Fozan increased his holdings by 250%, which is extremely bullish activity, especially given that the stock price has sunk 16.1% thus far in 2026. When the company reported revenue for the second quarter of 2026 on Aug. 10, it shared that total revenue increased by $155.6 million from the prior-year period to $228.8 million. It is burning through more money, however, as Bitdeer reported a net loss of $92.3 million for the quarter compared to a loss of $62.9 milion in the prior-year period.

For the Bitdeer stock price, analysts are just as bullish, and Fozan's purchase suggests what could be ahead for the company. Of the 13 analysts who cover Bitdeer and are tracked by CNN, 92% rate Bitdeer stock as a buy. Of those analysts, the median one-year price target is $21, representing a 92.4% gain from today's price. The group's highest price target is $35, and the lowest targets the stock at $10, right around its current price.

news.Title: Are Computer and Technology Stocks Lagging  Entegris (ENTG) This Year?
news.Content:
Investors interested in Computer and Technology stocks should always be looking to find the best-performing companies in the group. Has Entegris (ENTG) been one of those stocks this year? Let's take a closer look at the stock's year-to-date performance to find out.

Entegris is one of 614 companies in the Computer and Technology group. The Computer and Technology group currently sits at #3 within the Zacks Sector Rank. The Zacks Sector Rank considers 16 different sector groups. The average Zacks Rank of the individual stocks within the groups is measured, and the sectors are listed from best to worst.

The Zacks Rank emphasizes earnings estimates and estimate revisions to find stocks with improving earnings outlooks. This system has a long record of success, and these stocks tend to be on track to beat the market over the next one to three months. Entegris is currently sporting a Zacks Rank of #2 (Buy).

Within the past quarter, the Zacks Consensus Estimate for ENTG's full-year earnings has moved 9% higher. This signals that analyst sentiment is improving and the stock's earnings outlook is more positive.

Based on the latest available data, ENTG has gained about 70.5% so far this year. Meanwhile, the Computer and Technology sector has returned an average of 15.7% on a year-to-date basis. This means that Entegris is performing better than its sector in terms of year-to-date returns.

Arista Networks (ANET) is another Computer and Technology stock that has outperformed the sector so far this year. Since the beginning of the year, the stock has returned 44%.

Over the past three months, Arista Networks' consensus EPS estimate for the current year has increased 14.2%. The stock currently has a Zacks Rank #1 (Strong Buy).

Looking more specifically, Entegris belongs to the Electronics - Semiconductors industry, which includes 49 individual stocks and currently sits at #38 in the Zacks Industry Rank. This group has gained an average of 27.5% so far this year, so ENTG is performing better in this area.

Arista Networks, however, belongs to the Internet - Software industry. Currently, this 174-stock industry is ranked #75. The industry has moved -4.2% so far this year.

Investors interested in the Computer and Technology sector may want to keep a close eye on Entegris and Arista Networks as they attempt to continue their solid performance.
